short_bio: Comedian and host of The Tonight Show since 2014.
biography:
Jimmy Fallon was born in Brooklyn and raised in Saugerties, New York, and attended the College of Saint Rose. He joined the cast of Saturday Night Live in 1998 and anchored its Weekend Update segment with Tina Fey.

He left in 2004 for film work and returned to television in 2009 as the host of Late Night, succeeding Conan O’Brien.

In February 2014 he took over The Tonight Show from Jay Leno; the format leans on games, sketches and musical bits with the house band The Roots.
